Oysters natural.d: Opened to order on crushed ice. Shallots in red wine vinegar, cracked pepper, lemon.
Oysters natural.note: Six for 6.50 at the raw bar.

Fish and chip cones.d: White fillets in a cold lager batter, fried crisp. Twice-cooked fries, tartar sauce and lemon, in a paper cone.
Fish and chip cones.note: Hold on to the cone at the rail.

Whole lobster.d: About 1¼ lb, split and brushed with garlic butter, then finished under the broiler. A cup of drawn butter, lemon, crackers and a bib.

Ocean blue jelly cups.d: Coconut cream set firm, a clear sea-coloured layer poured over, gummy fish on top.
Ocean blue jelly cups.note: From the galley on every sailing.

Blue lagoon.d: Vodka and curaçao over ice, topped with lemonade and a lemon wheel.
